title: Caffeine
about: A playful memory of always losing the same lighthearted argument over caffeine.
description: This track remembers a recurring little exchange over caffeine. I would tell her she probably shouldn't have it, she'd already know exactly what I was going to say, and somehow the conversation would always end with both of us smiling and her walking away with the drink anyway. It wasn't really about caffeine or who was right. It was about her playful confidence and the way she could turn a disagreement into another small memory worth keeping.
lyrics: You already knew what I'd say
Before we even reached the stand.
You smiled before I shook my head,
You'd flash that look across your face...
And somehow I knew I wouldn't win.
You'd grin, lean a little closer,
And suddenly it wasn't my choice.
I don't remember what you said...
I only know how it would end.
While you walked away with caffeine.
You had a way of winning
